description: We are enthusiastic first-year IT students passionate about space, technology, and creativity. Our project, “Abandoned but Not Forgotten,” explores the stories of NASA’s retired spacecraft. We welcome coders, web developers, graphic designers, storytellers, and space enthusiasts. Beginners with creative ideas and a willingness to learn are welcome. Let’s make forgotten space stories unforgettable!

AFTER THE MISSION: The Untold Stories of Humanity’s Forgotten Space Explorers

AFTER THE MISSION is an illustrated educational storybook developed by Team AstraCore to explore what happens to spacecraft and vehicles after their missions end. Through an engaging storytelling approach, it takes readers on a journey across three destinations: the Moon, Mars, and asteroid 433 Eros.

The story introduces the Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicles, NASA’s Opportunity rover, and the NEAR Shoemaker spacecraft, explaining their missions, discoveries, final resting places, and scientific contributions. By combining historical NASA mission information, educational explanations, illustrations, and fictional character dialogues, the project makes space exploration interesting and easy to understand.

It addresses the challenge by bringing attention to forgotten space explorers and preserving awareness of their journeys beyond their operational lifetimes. The project highlights how their engineering achievements and scientific discoveries continue to inspire future generations of scientists, engineers, and space explorers.
details:
Project Details – AFTER THE MISSION

AFTER THE MISSION is an illustrated educational storybook created by Team AstraCore to bring attention to spacecraft and vehicles that remain in space after completing their missions.

The project works through a storytelling approach, taking readers across three destinations: the Moon, Mars, and asteroid 433 Eros. It introduces three important explorers: the Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicles, NASA’s Opportunity rover, and the NEAR Shoemaker spacecraft. Through historical information, illustrations, fictional character dialogues, and mission comparisons, readers learn about their purposes, discoveries, final resting places, and scientific contributions.

The main benefit of this project is making space science more interesting, understandable, and accessible, especially for students and young learners. Its intended impact is to increase awareness about past space missions, preserve their scientific legacy, and inspire future generations to explore science, technology, and engineering.

Tools and Technologies: We developed this project as a digital PDF storybook using digital document and design tools. We used NASA’s publicly available mission information and references for research. No coding languages or hardware were required.

Creativity and Innovation: Instead of presenting spacecraft information as a conventional research report, we transformed their journeys into an illustrated adventure with fictional character dialogues, destination-based chapters, and a mission comparison.

Factors Considered: We considered historical accuracy, educational value, storytelling quality, readability, visual presentation, and the importance of explaining what happens to space explorers after their missions end.

AFTER THE MISSION reminds us that even when a spacecraft stops operating, its discoveries and contributions continue to inspire humanity.
